cause_quote: The new `externalPublication` check required `initial.phase === "publishing"` or a `superseded` record with the external-settlement intent, so a `prepared` record skipped verification even when the live package matched the candidate.
user_saw: When an external install made the candidate live while the activation journal still said `prepared`, `openclaw update repair` reported an incomplete publication and subsequent updates stayed blocked.
summary: The fix lets `openclaw update repair` verify and settle a `prepared` activation when the live package already serves the recorded candidate, preserving the recovery evidence and clearing the update block.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its parent: before #165607, a matching candidate with an unchanged lease was routed back to pending recovery, and #165607 introduced verified settlement while excluding `prepared` records. A later diff added `publication-complete` while preserving that exclusion, so the prepared case had been missing since verified settlement shipped.
